title: Rename TaskMetadata.status to progress
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Rename TaskMetadata.status to progress
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L398: "- `task`: `{\"title\": \"...\", \"progress\": \"...\"}`"; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md L200 (clarifying): "`progress` (String) — the Task's current `progress` value ({{RFC8984, Section 5.2.5}}; e.g., `\"needs-action\"`, `\"in-process\"`, `\"completed\"`, `\"cancelled\"`), or its `workflowStatus` ... when `progress` is not set."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:100-105 (pub status: Option<String>, wire key "status")
Now: TaskMetadata serializes and deserializes the key "status". A conformant sender's "progress" lands in `extra`, and our sender emits "status", which receivers ignore.
Change: Rename the field to `progress` (wire "progress") and update its doc. Also check crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs fixtures and chat-tasks-server for the key. The tasks draft is the primary source.

[chat-ext] Rename TaskMetadata.status to progress
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md:200 "`progress` (String) — the Task's current `progress` value ({{RFC8984, Section 5.2.5}}; e.g., `\"needs-action\"`, `\"in-process\"`, `\"completed\"`, `\"cancelled\"`), or its `workflowStatus` ({{JMAP-TASKS, Section 4}}) when `progress` is not set." (replaces the old `status` key)
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:101-104 (pub status: Option<String>, serialized as "status"); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs:171,180,214
Now: TaskMetadata serializes and deserializes the key "status". A spec-conformant "progress" key lands in `extra`, and the code emits "status", which peers ignore as an unknown key.
Change: Rename the field to `progress: Option<String>` (wire key "progress") and update the doc to say it carries progress, or workflowStatus when progress is unset. Update the test oracles to the new draft text.
